name: edge-preserving-update
body: Edge-preserving update: every entity has an `update` that reads the existing record, mutates only its allowed fields (identity — layer/type/name, or edge kind/from/to — is never mutable), and writes back with all existing out/in (or plan) edges intact. Concretely: a node body/property update keeps its incident authored edges; a phase update keeps its task Contains edges; a task update keeps its status and Reviews edges; an edge property update rewrites both halves in agreement.
